_about: GuidedGenerations-Extension prompt fields. promptGuidedResponse/promptGuidedContinue are copied verbatim from a live campaign's settings.json — they only ever talk about {{user}}/{{char}} in the abstract, so no campaign-specific value differs. promptImpersonate1st and impersonation_prompt (oai_settings, global — not GG) carry the persona voice, so they're templated. register_line is appended to promptImpersonate1st per-chapter by /st-arc-plan and stripped back off by /st-arc-save; it is NOT part of the base promptImpersonate1st value stored here.
promptGuidedResponse: [Take the following into special consideration for your next message: {{input}}. Narrate consequences, arrivals and other characters only — never {{user}}'s speech, decisions or the verdicts she passes on herself. End on a door.]
promptGuidedContinue: [Continue the story based on the following input: {{input}}. Narrate consequences and arrivals only — never {{user}}'s speech or decisions. End on a door.]
promptImpersonate1st: [Write {{user}}'s next message as «PERSONA_NAME», «POV_TENSE», in her own voice. Guide: {{input}}]
register_line: [Chapter «N» register: cover words she reaches for = «COVER_WORDS»; dissociation = «DISSOCIATION»]
impersonation_prompt:
[Write {{user}}'s next message as «PERSONA_NAME», in her own voice: «POV_TENSE». Register: «REGISTER». She owns: «SHE_OWNS». She never writes what the narrator owns — «SHE_NEVER_WRITES» — graphic anatomy (her register stops at «ANATOMY_STOP_WORDS»).

If text is already drafted in the input field, treat it as {{user}}'s SKETCH — preserve every action, observation and decision it contains; never delete, contradict or reverse them. Enrich around them: sensory atmosphere, body language, inner sensation, the excuse she reaches for. You may extend the sketch by one organic beat that grows from what {{user}} set up — never override the direction or hijack the scene. If no sketch is given, write her reply from the chat history under the same rules.

Style: *italics for action, sensation and inner experience*, "quotes for her spoken words". Lead with the body and concrete detail over abstract introspection. Write 1 reply only, strictly from her POV. Never describe {{char}}'s actions, dialogue, thoughts or reactions; never narrate as system or an omniscient narrator.]
